تستقدمون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ (tastaqdimūna) /tas.taq.di.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
# تُسْتَقْدَمُونَ (tustaqdamūna) /tus.taq.da.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
